name: Mimei
source: A young woman from a small northern village who, armed with a snake's eye umbrella and the unique ability to see the future, sets out to eliminate the Kogori Demons plaguing a remote island. Outwardly calm, yet inwardly insecure, she soon discovers her task to be far more challenging than she ever could have imagined.
